Multimedia Accessibility Review : Evaluate captions, transcripts, and audio descriptions for accuracy, synchronization, and natural language, and confirm multimedia controls are properly labeled in the target language. Defect Reporting : Log findings with WCAG/PDF-UA references, supporting screenshots or recordings, and severity classifications; participate in review calls with the QA Lead as needed. What We Are Looking For Required Native or near-native fluency in Chinese Simplified ; you are the authoritative voice on whether translated content reads naturally and is understandable. Demonstrated hands-on experience testing digital content with assistive technology/AT. Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 AA and EN 301 549. Ability to evaluate content from a native-speaker accessibility perspective — not just technical compliance, but real-world usability for screen reader users who speak the language. Reliable access to relevant devices and operating systems to replicate real-world usage in the target locale.
